candidate_space.readbacks: dagc_val (p3 0x05, Table 10); if_agc_val (p3 0x59-0x5A), rf_agc_val (p3 0x5B-0x5C), aagc_lock (p3 0x50) (Table 2); sfreq_off (p3 0x18-0x19), cfreq_off (p3 0x5F-0x61) (Table 12); inc_det_cnt (p3 0x28-0x29) (Table 9); Est_kq, Est_sin (p1 0x66-0x69) (Table 5); tuner R1-R4 ([R820T2] Table 1-2); page 3 whole with --page3
candidate_space.divider_probe: every SEL_DIV code 0..=7 at the frequency; the documented codes with their divider, the undescribed ones under each hypothesis 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32; configurations manual and vagc; tone off then on at the start level; a readback that moves marks the code as locking
candidate_space.configurations: manual (every gain manual); vagc (VGA_MODE = 1, IF gain from the VAGC pin) with polar_if_agc 0 and 1; auto (LNA and mixer gain auto, detectors 1 and 3 on)
candidate_space.source_ladder: off; txvga [0, 5, 10, 15, 20] x backoff [-20, -12, -6, 0] in ascending level; off again

source.levels: relative only: txvga nominally 1 dB per step, backoff exact digital scaling (DAC-quantised below about -40 dB); the tone sits at the offset above the source's LO, whose leakage is that far below the tone
